gri_path: GRI 1: first-named article is the DC vibrator motor, an electric motor of heading 8501; Section XVI note 2(a) keeps a motor in its own heading even if used as a component of another device

GRI 6: 8501.10 output not exceeding 37.5 W (miniature vibrator motors are well under 1 W); 8501.10.40 under 18.65 W, other than synchronous; DC; not brushless (typical brushed vibrator motor), suffix 60
The listed parts are classified separately: housing and spring contact under 8503.00.95 (parts solely or principally for motors, Section XVI note 2(b)); rubber grommet in 4016 (Section XVI note 1(a))

classification.rationale: The first-named article is a complete DC vibrator motor, which is an electric motor of heading 8501 under GRI 1. Such motors are miniature and far below 18.65 W, so they fall in 8501.10.40 (other than synchronous), and as DC motors that are typically brushed they take suffix 60 (DC, other). The separate parts (housing, spring contact) would go to 8503 under Section XVI note 2(b), and the rubber grommet to 4016.
